title: Ekdotico controlled vocabulary
description: Schema for expression/vocabulary.json. Validated in CI, so a malformed term fails the build rather than silently disabling a rule the linter would otherwise enforce.

version.description: Must match the version in prohibited.json and the guidelines header.

notes.description: Explanations of the optional term fields, kept beside the data rather than only in the prose document.

id.description: Stable identifier. Forms the linter rule id as vocabulary/<id>, so renaming one breaks existing overrides.

concept.description: What the term names, phrased so it reads correctly inside a finding message.

shorthand.description: Permitted only after the canonical term has appeared once in the same document or screen.

variants.description: Unambiguous non-canonical forms. A match is a blocking finding.

ambiguousVariants.description: Forms that are also ordinary English or legitimate domain terms. A match is substantive and asks for human confirmation.

notDetectable.description: Known non-canonical forms the linter deliberately does not match. Requires notDetectableReason.

allowedCompounds.description: Longer forms that remain correct, typically a module title rather than a product surface.

scope.description: Canonical in specification and engineering contexts but not a user-facing label. Requires scopeNote.

rationale.description: Why this term and not another. A term without a recorded reason cannot be defended when someone proposes changing it.

gaps.description: Concepts that recur without a canonical term. Gaps in the guidelines, not failures of the content; the linter does not flag them.

observed.description: At least two forms in circulation. One form is a term, not a gap.
